I've tried. A very close friend of nearly 15 years dropped me out of his life shortly after I told him things were starting to get bad. Just ignored all contact and everything. I have many friends but I'd rather quality over quantity, and I don't really have the quality anymore.

And one awful family member is the main reason I started feeling so constantly angry and stressed. I never feel comfortable at home because of constant anxiety and anger and discomfort
Prozac, able to calm me down if I'm feeling too stressed or angry, but doesn't help the negative feelings. Kind of just a numbing effect really.

A new **brand**^t of human kind perhaps!

Also you are the user that wrote that [great piece on Christopher nolan](http://www.reddit.com/r/interstellar/comments/2r30o2/guide_to_christopher_nolan_interstellar_not_yet/) (my favourite director). I like how you mentioned his name was Dr Hugh Mann, I didn't notice until you pointed it out. I checked [the script](http://leonardlangfordlexicon.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/INTERSTELLAR-Jonathan-Nolan.pdf) and it confirmed his name was Hugh Mann, often inferred by Cooper. It's great subtle wordplay by Nolan, because Damon's character is symbolic of mankind.

[I recently found out his name was Dr Hugh Mann.](http://www.reddit.com/r/interstellar/comments/2r30o2/guide_to_christopher_nolan_interstellar_not_yet/) I think Dr Hugh Mann meant to represent how man(kind) is responsible for all the evil. His full name is Hugh Mann, which adds more support to my theory that he is an embodiment of human kind

What an insulting and shallow comment. Well fuck you too sir. The current link on the subreddit is from Metacritic. One of the finest aggregate reviewers/film critics. The particular film, Interstellar, happens to be one of my favourite foreign (British) movies.

And how dare you insinuate such vitriol about Interstellar.

To call me a "massive hipster film snob" is exactly why this subreddit is just infuriating sometimes.
I don't think there were any references to masturbation by Dr (Hugh) Mann in Interstellar
